definition_and_derivation: Calendar year; complete 2000-2023 grid.
historical means retrospective reconstruction, not historically available information.
Canonical policy-family ID or RES_sector. IRL IDs link to prior ChatGPT; CAPMF IDs identify added/consolidated anchors.
Clean name or explicit instrument family; residual row is a sector summary.
L1 framework, L2 instrument, L3 delivery programme, or residual. Never sum L1 with other layers.
Sector and mechanism grouping; pricing also distinguishes ETS/ESR. Frameworks and residuals have separate bundle names.
Eight requested sectors plus Cross-sectoral for national L1 frameworks only.
1 when a canonical policy has multiple sector slices, or residual members include such policies. Repeated rows do not imply allocated effects.
Affected ETS, ESR-compatible non-ETS, LULUCF, or Mixed scope. ESR is a harmonised non-ETS label, not a claim that the Regulation existed in 2000.
Reviewed mechanism; residual uses mixed because one sector residual can contain different mechanisms.
Primary source instrument label, with explicit substantive corrections for LIEN and VRT; original labels remain in raw input.
CO2, CH4, N2O, F-gases, All or semicolon-separated combination. Liming includes CO2 noted in its description; no gas-level tonnes inferred.
EEA, CAPMF or EEA+CAPMF identifies the policy database lineage. Additional official documents verify dates/scope.
Historical source PaM IDs contributing to this row/family/residual. WAM IDs are not included here.
Matched LEV4 preferred or LEV3 code(s); no parent-child mix in a score. Residual lists member codes but has no aggregate raw score.
exact: same instrument/scope; close: instrument family; partial: contextual proxy; none: unmatched. These are judgments, not probabilities.
materiality_90pct, anchor_capmf, residual. An anchor can also pass materiality; separate flags retain both decisions.
Descending positive effect rank within the primary selection sector. A merged family displays the minimum member rank; see selection log for all ranks.
Reported total used for selection, repeated across years and sector slices. Family sums are selection bookkeeping only, not independent measured effects. Blank for residual.
First numeric: expost_2024, exante_2025_WEM, exante_2030; zero/negative values stop fallback. Family may list several sources; residual is not_quantified.
Selected start or instrument-family boundary. CAPMF first-positive dates are explicitly distinguished from verified legal dates. Residual uses earliest member start.
Reported end of source phase, inclusive. Blank for open/continuing families; residual is blank if any member is open.
pre_implementation, active, post_expiry_residual, post_expiry_no_effect; extended unknown/mixed states are permitted where evidence requires.
year minus selected start, including negative values before the start; residual uses earliest start.
Independent observed rate/uptake/expenditure only. Entire column blank in this release because no such annual series was supplied/imported.
Unit of the independent observed value; blank in this release.
capmf_derived or assumed here; observed reserved. assumed includes structural pre-start zeros and explicit no-effect zeros, distinguished in implementation_detail.
Same-year CAPMF/10 when matched and available; otherwise supplied hypothetical timing. After expiry, last operational level seeds a conditional assumed half-life tail.
Same-year raw CAPMF score; strict mean of distinct matched codes where needed. M, K and blank A are missing. Never backcast/forward-fill.
User-specified 0.1/0.25/0.5/1 scope rubric. Despite the required column name this is NOT a measured activity or emissions share. Residual: mean member score.
Specific reason for the ordinal scope choice; fixed and provisional.
User rubric: enforcement 1, pricing/statutory obligation .75, incentive .5, information/voluntary .25; statutory frameworks 1. Residual: member mean.
implementation_level * coverage_share * bindingness. Residual exception: strict mean of member intensity products. Relative scenario indicator, not causal effect.
Literal mean of implementation_level, coverage_share, bindingness. It stays positive before implementation; use the gated companion for timing sensitivity.
Source conflicts, proxy scope, ordinal judgments, hypothetical timing, source changes, family consolidation and residual rules.
Source register, attached record identifiers and full official citations with retrieval status. Indexed-only evidence remains identified.
Claude timing class; framework fallback is a separate conventional class; residual is mixed.
Every source variant for lineage, including planned WAM/NIPS. These do not become historical policy records.
Prior ChatGPT policy identities represented by the canonical row.
Claude Uxxx units linked through original PaM IDs.
Instrument/family or category/framework context. Contextual stringency does not measure programme-specific implementation.
At least one source member passed the sector 90% algorithm.
Retained under the reviewed CAPMF anchor rule.
2024, 2025 or 2030; blank when family sources span years or no single estimate applies.
positive, negative, reported_zero, missing, family_selection_sum or mixed residual evidence.
Exact EEA field(s) used for selection.
Primary sector to which an unallocated reported policy total is assigned once for ranking; carbon tax is anchor-only Cross-sectoral.
Selection total only on the primary-sector slice; never a measured sector allocation. Repeated over time; residual blank.
Source and interpretation of the start, including timing conflicts and first-positive category boundaries.
continues/ends from source narrative, not_applicable_open, unknown, or mixed; says nothing about validated duration.
Reason for the normative score, not evidence of observed compliance.
Original workbook row numbers including the header offset.
Framework context never aggregate; family representative excludes child duplicates; portfolio choose parent or delivery schemes; residual do not also include members.
Prior identities or canonical residual members; detailed residual contributions are in qa/residual_members.csv.
Distinguishes CAPMF, timing fallback, structural zero, assumed legacy tail and residual averaging.
Original OECD A/E/K/M flags, or unavailable; multiple flags for multiple codes. E remains estimated.
Hypothetical midyear ramp/legacy profile, even when CAPMF owns implementation_level. Never an empirically estimated response. Residual blank.
Claude supplied default lag; judgment scenario.
Claude supplied duration of linear phase-in; judgment scenario.
Claude supplied post-expiry half-life, applied only if source supports continued effects.
Parameters explicitly unvalidated; framework legal-presence fallback is conventional.
Literal equal mean set to zero before start/after explicit end of effect; legacy years retain the mean. Residual mean of member gated values.
ordinal_scope_not_measured_share.
Warns that effect values repeat by year/sector and must not be summed.
CAPMF code set or unmatched policy ID. Shared code sets reveal duplicated contextual information across different named measures.
Residual fixed-denominator analytical member count; one for each core analytical component even if it consolidates several source vintages.
Members with nonmissing intensity. Residual means remain missing unless all fixed members are available.
